measurement_scope: perf_counter_ns immediately before/after frozen evaluate_point: original fresh N30 GDP construction, constructor initialization, external fixing, logical/GDP transformations and original preprocessing until rejection returns; no solver; excludes batch source imports/preloading, CSV/checkpoint IO, logging, provenance and output generation

dfo.per_visit_cost_policy: Sum each callback, including repeated points and initial/failed callbacks; no cache deduplication
dfo.cost_interpretation: Reconstructed from separate process measurements; not measured online DFO runtime
